summary: Frontend testing of page-specific Vendor Query modal variants and Login hero-banner. Most acceptance criteria PASS. CRITICAL: existing-vendors clickable chip list on not-found panel is NOT implemented — no chips render in .modal-body regardless of whether vendors exist in storage.

ui_bugs.issue:
Not-found panel does NOT render existing vendors as clickable chips. Verified with 1 saved vendor (Alpha) — after an empty/invalid search, modal-body contains only the Query button (no chip buttons). Code in VendorQueryModal.jsx lines 119-123 only renders the red 'No vendor found'

; there is no chip list rendering (no getAllVendors call, no chip mapping).

issues: React DOM warning in console: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' — appears to be caused by data-tagging wrapper inside <option> elements in GST_SLABS <select>. Non-blocking but pollutes console and can cause hydration errors.

action_items: Implement existing-vendors chip list inside VendorQueryModal not-found panel: render clickable buttons for each vendor (from getAllVendors) below the 'No vendor found' text; clicking a chip should populate data-testid=query-input with that vendor's vendorCode (or tempRefId) and preferably auto-run the query.
Also render chips proactively when input is empty & user clicks Query (already triggers notFound=true with empty q) — current behavior confirmed.
Fix <span> inside <option> DOM warning on /bill (likely from static-data-tagging wrapper around GST_SLABS options).
critical_code_review_comments: VendorQueryModal.jsx: notFound branch only renders a message; requirement specifies clickable chips of existing vendors — feature missing.
modal-eyebrow/modal-title correctly switch per variant (vendor/bill/final) — good.
Variant-based field hiding (Bank/IFSC/Account) works correctly for bill and final variants.
Payment Vouchers hidden on 'bill' variant and Bill History hidden on 'final' variant — matches spec.
seed_data_creation: Saved 1 vendor: Firm='Alpha', Mobile='9000000001' via /vendor Save button for chip/query tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All variant modal labels/field-visibility/table-visibility pass. Regression pass: /final has exactly 1 .a4; top-action-bar has btn-search, btn-prev-page/btn-next-page, btn-new/save/edit/submit/approve/export/print, btn-change-logo, btn-logout. Only missing implementation is the existing-vendors chip list on not-found (see action_items).
